facts.label: Satchel bombs
facts.value: Satchel bombs go in the thrown-weapon slot and run from Copper up to Dark Iron (skill 285, Honored).

facts.label: Clanking Cord belts
facts.value: Engineers can make Clanking Cord belts for each armor type.

facts.label: Skill scaling
facts.value: Icy Veins says some gadgets now scale with your Engineering skill.

facts.label: Gnome racial
facts.value: Gnome Engineering Specialization no longer adds skill. It now cuts the failure and backfire rate of engineering devices by 20%.

facts.label: Camp objects
facts.value: Three objects unlock at skills 20, 140 and 300, the last being the Anarchist's Workbench. The skill-140 blueprint drops from Sneed in the Deadmines.

facts.label: Skill ranks
facts.value: Apprentice up to 75, Journeyman up to 150 (skill 50, level 10), Expert up to 225 (skill 125, level 20) and Artisan up to 300 (skill 200, level 35). 300 is the cap.

facts.label: Specialization (Classic baseline)
facts.value: Classic 1.12: a quest at skill 200 makes you a Goblin or Gnomish engineer. Goblin engineers get Dimensional Ripper - Everlook; Gnomish engineers get Ultrasafe Transporter: Gadgetzan and World Enlarger. Switching means unlearning.
facts.note: Forever guides list the same choice.

facts.label: Favor recipes
facts.value: SAF-T Dynamite costs 45 Merchant's Favor at skill 25. The Emergency Field Cloak needs Honored and 270 Favor, and the Gnomish Poultryizer needs skill 300 and 360 Favor.

facts.label: Legacy
facts.value: The first time you reach 150, 225 and 300 in a craft you earn 1 Legacy point each. Performance Bonus adds extra Merchant's Favor, and Working Overtime improves your skill-up chance.

facts.label: SAF-T explosives
facts.value: Non-engineers can use SAF-T explosives such as SAF-T Dynamite (skill 25), so an engineer can hand them out to the group.

facts.label: Emergency Field Cloak
facts.value: An invisibility trinket that is Bind on Pickup: only the engineer who makes it can use it.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Where the Anarchist's Workbench blueprint drops.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Whether the Goblin and Gnomish specialization quests are unchanged from Classic.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Which gadgets scale with Engineering skill, and by how much.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Final Favor prices and reputation gates for engineering recipes.

facts.label: Professions window
facts.value: Professions have their own window, opened with K. Recipe lists can be searched and filtered, and you can track a recipe in the objectives frame.

facts.label: Camp buffs
facts.value: Profession camp objects give weaker copies of class buffs that do not stack with the real ones. You sit at the camp for at least 1 minute to get them.

facts.label: Campsite size
facts.value: A basic campsite holds 3 camp features, one per player. Cooking upgrades raise this to 5 or 10.

facts.label: Earning Merchant's Favor
facts.value: Fill Waylaid Crates (found in the world or bought on the Auction House) and hand the sealed crates to Marcy Baker of the Azeroth Commerce Authority at Three Corners in western Redridge. Craftsman's Writs add reputation.

facts.label: Profession title
facts.value: Crafters who reach 300 can earn a certification item that unlocks a profession title. Alliance players get it from the Azeroth Commerce Authority.

facts.label: Vendor prices
facts.value: Blizzard's beta notes say many profession-made items sell to vendors for less.
facts.gameBuild: WoW: Forever (Blizzard beta notes of 16 Oct 2026)

facts.label: Raid explosives (Classic baseline)
facts.value: Classic 1.12: caster consumable guides list Goblin Sapper Charge, Thorium Grenade and Dark Iron Bomb for engineers.
